text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer.
...As I thought—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I...
want to run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
With Big sis. And with Vivlos.
...I want to face them on the track.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
For the Japan Cup...
If doing so will make me stronger—!
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll get your race entry registered.
Got it. I'll get your race entry registered.

text_block_list.text: And so, the three-sister showdown at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is set to become a reality—!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, found you, found youuu~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Che~ va~ chi♡
Fooooound you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We're really running together today!
Ah, geez, I can't stop the excitement~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's right before the race...
You're getting way too hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Because, because, I'm just so happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, guess what!
I watched the Japan Cup special!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chi, with her absolute victory declaration!
She was sooooo cool!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...So you see, I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"In this race,
I'll be your courage, Cheval-chi!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She beat Cheva-chi and Big Sis both,
and then, get this--

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Even my little sister, who used to be so tiny, has gotten this strong! That's right—I should be able to do it too!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Juuust kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm going to be a bit stricter than that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Big sister—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You can call me that, if you like.
Though today, I didn't come here
as your older sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The one worthy of bearing the title of "Queen"
is none other than myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You might have grown stronger too,
—but you still have a long way to go."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what true, greater strength looks like.
Come at me, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oh, ooh!
Ooooooohhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOHHHH!!
Here it comes, here it comes, here it comes, here it coooomes!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Verxina!!
Vivlos!!
And—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
It's Cheval Grand!!
It's a real three-sister showdown, whoaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...What incredible cheering.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Back then... I never would've imagined it.
The three of us, soaking in the cheers like this.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Even though Sis... and Vivlos are right here with me.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina Fan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek~~~, Lady Verxina!!
We're looking forward to another magnificent run today~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the cheers.
...Allow me to show you a run worthy of the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos Fan
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOH, Vivlos--!!
Don't let your big sisters beat ya!
Show 'em what a genius you areee--!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thanks~☆
Alright, I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Even though two such radiant, sparkling girls are together—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-kuuuuun!!
Do your beeeest--!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em, Cheval Grand!!
Don't lose to your big sister or your little sisterーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...There are people looking out for me, too.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Before, I wouldn't have even considered it.
...But now—!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... th-thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Me too.
...I will show you my strength.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Please... watch over me...!
